tei:div.tei:p: (209)kha bskang rnams phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bzhugs so/ (210)

de nas byin dbab pa ni/ bka' ma rong phur las/ hūm̐/ gdal ba chen po chos dbyings pho brang nas/ rdo rje 'jin rgyal sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i rje/ byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs mjad pa/ phur pa grub pa'i rig 'jin brgyud par bcas/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis/ sku (211)gsung thugs dag yon tan phrin las kyi/ mthu dbang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir/ dbyings nas 'dir gshegs dkyil 'khor byin phob cig oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra a be sha ya a a a/ bka' ma rog phur las/ hūm̐/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i (212)dkyil 'khor du/ nyi zla pad+ma lha chen gdan stengs du/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas/ rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsaul/ bh+rūm̐ tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ dam tshig pas ye shes pa la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ srid gsum gdug pa 'dul ba dang*/ nga rgyal zhen pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ rdo rje srin po 'khor bcas la/ rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ a ti pu hoḥ pra tī ts+tsha (213)hoḥ rong phur las/ hūm̐/ dag cing dri med mchod yon dam pa dang*/ me tog bdug spos snang gsalal byug pa dang*/ zhal zas sgra snyan la sogs mchod pa'i sprin/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pas/ chos dbyings nam mkha'i khams rnams yongs bkang ste/ zag med bde skyid kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ srid pa ci srid 'byung bar byin rlabs te/ rdo rje phur pa'i (214)dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ auṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ ni wi d+ye/ shap+ta pū ja me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ gnyis pa 'dod yon gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gzug kyi lha mo yid 'ong ma/ dkar mo mjes ma me long 'jin/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ spyan gyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig

sgra yi lha mo yid 'ong ma/ ser mo dbyangs snyan pi waṃ 'jin/ (215)dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ snyan gyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig dri yi lha mo yid 'ong ma/ sngon mo mjes ma spos phor 'jin/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ shangs kyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig ro yi lha mo yid 'ong ma/ dmar mo mjes ma zhal zas 'jin/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ ljags kyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig reg bya'i (216)lha mo yid 'ong ma/ ljang gu pañtsa li ka 'jin/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ sku yi mchod pa mnyes gyur cig chos kyi lha mo yid 'ong ma/ mthing ga chos kyi 'byung gnas 'jin/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ thugs kyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ ghan+dhe/ ra pa/ spar+she/ dharmā kwa ma gu ṇa pū ja hoḥ de nas phyag rgya'i mchod pa ni/ (217)hūm̐/ sku mdog zhal ni rnam par bsgyur/ sku yi gar stabs glog 'gyu bas/ 'bar ba'i khro bo mnyes bya ste/ phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ zhes lha rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan lam gyis gsal bas rung la/ gsang mchod ni/ rdo rje phur bu'i lha tshaugs la/ yid 'ong lha mo'i mchod pa 'bul/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba'i/ bdag nyid mnyes pas mnyes par mchod/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a nu rā ga ya hoḥ (218)a nu rā ga ya mye/ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de nas bdud rtsi'i 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ rgyud lnga sems can kun sgrol phyir/ dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen por/ bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags (219)kyis/ bzhes nas 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/

༈ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ rig 'jin brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'jigs byed chen po khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ za byed gsod (220)byed phra thabs bcu phrag gnyis/ pho brang bsrung ba'i sgo ma bzhi rnams la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ las bzhi'i phrin las mjad pa'i pho brang du/ sras mchog phur pa'i lha tshogs thams cad la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos (221)grub stsol/ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang*/ dam can bcu gnyis ging dang bcas pa la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ dge bsnyen nyer gcig brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs/ phur pa'i srung mar zhal (222)bzhes thams cad la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sdom la gnas shing rig 'jin sgrub pa po/ lha dang lha min phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ (223)lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la/ rdo rje can gyi hūm̐ bsgoms te/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i sman/ zos pas dngos grub gsum thob 'gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsirta sid+dhi pha la hoḥ raka ta 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/

dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas/ dmar (224)gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor 'khyil/ mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas kyi/ ma lus gshegs nas bsnams du gsol/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ ru tra mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang*/ gdul dka' rab tu 'dul ba'i phyir/ sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ hūm̐/ nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste/ 'khor ba'i ra bar chags pa yi/ dmar chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ la/ 'khor gyi (225)mkha' 'gro rnams dang rol/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā maṃ sa/ ma hā tsit+ta/ ma hā ba su ta/ ma hā go ro tsa na kong ni ri ti khā hi/ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hoḥ kha kha kha le le le/ hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ bh+yo/ de nas sgrol mchod ni/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ (226)bdag nyid chen po'i dus la bab/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab/ mthu rtsal byung ba'i dus la bab/ zhes bskul/ hūm̐/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ rig 'jin bdag cag rnams la ni/ gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ yid tsam gyis ni 'dir khug (227)la/ mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*/ lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang*/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mjod/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ mo ha ga ta ya bha ga wan/ shrī kri bi kri badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bigh+naṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud dang bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ sdug bsngal sems la mnyam sbyar ba'i/ che ge mo zhes bya (228)ba 'di/

zug shig ching shig rnam par chings/ gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ rings par khug la smrar chug cig phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang*/ bsgo ba'i bka' la 'dun par gyis/ hūm̐ pa ra bid+ya ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ trā sa ya trā sa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hrīḥdaṇ+ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ shrī gh+raṃ a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ (229)dz+wa la ya dz+wa la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ a be sha ya a be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pas/ mngon spyod phrin las tshul bzhin mjod/ ha na ha na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ pu ru pu ru badz+ra/ mu ru mu ru badz+ra/ ka ṭa ya ka ṭa ya/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a ji te/ a (230)pa ra ji te/ mā ra pya na pra marta na ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ stobs chen khro+i bo chen po yis/ klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ nga yis bka' las 'da' ma byed/ hūm̐ ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ma taṃ nya ka ra i nan dha dhi ma ma shī gh+raṃ ka ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ zungs shig lha min lha yang rung*/ nga la bar (231)chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ sarba ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ rdo rje me dpal snying bsregs nas/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brdung*/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas/ lha yang rung te brlag par bya'o/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa (232)phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bsgral la gtor mar sbran dmar sbreng*/

ma hā māṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsirta/ ba su ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bstab/ lha rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ 'dod pa'i yon tan mang pos rab brgyan te/ thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes nas kyang*/ bdag la (233)dngos grub ma lus rtsal du gsol/ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka yi daṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī paṃ/ ghan+dhe/ ba ling+ta/ pū ja hoḥ pra tits+tsha khā hi/ gṝh+na khā hi/ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lha thams cad dgyes nas ha ha zhes bzhad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gsung nas bdag la byin gyis brlabs/ phaṭa phaṭa zhes gsung nas dgra bgegs bsgral te chos nyid du gnas spar bar bsam mo/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan che ba'i che mchog lha yi lha/ dus gsum (234)bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ phrin las thams cad rjogs pa'i dpal chen po/ he ru ka dpal khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ 'jigs byed 'das pa'i dus na mngon byung ba/ sku gsum rdzogs pa'i khro rgyal phur pa'i lha/ srid rtsa'i bdag 'jin ru tra sde gsum 'dul/ rtsal chen phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ gtum chen brjid pa 'gying zhing sgeg pa'i sku/ bdud tshogs sde bcas 'dul ba'i dpal bo che/ mi (235)sdug srin po khros 'dra'i cha lugs kyis/ srid gsum gdug pa 'dul mjad khyod la bstod/ bzhad sgra 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i gad rgyangs can/ drag shul chen pos ri rab thal bar brlag 'jigs rung rtsal gyis khams gsum dus gcig sgrol/ dpal chen khro bo'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig chen po yis/ 'gro kun byang chub snying por 'dren mjad cing*/ thugs (236)rje'i dbyings nas khros pa'i rngams stabs kyis/ 'khor ba gtan nas brlag byed khyod la bstod/

gdug can drag pos 'dul bar nyer dgongs nas/ 'bar ba'i khro tshul du ma'i gar mjad yang*/ chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang las mi g.yo ba/ dpal chen mngon rdzogs rgyal po khyod la bstod/ nam mkha'i khams kun yongs su khyab pa'i sku/ gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gza' skar yang*/ sku yi rgyan du che ba'i dpal chen po/ (237)che btsan 'gran zla bral ba khyod la bstod/ gnyen po ye shes gzhom gzhig med mnga' bas/ nyon mongs rtog pa'i bdud tshogs tshar gcod phyir/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu'i 'phyar ba yis/ ri rab chen po kun kyang thal bar rlog bdud dang 'byung po kun gyi klad pa 'gems/ srid pa'i 'gong po spun dgu rdul du rlog 'gro rnams theg pa dgu yi lam la 'dren/ bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa yis/ (238)nyon mongs dug lnga gtan nas brlag byed cing*/ don dam spros med byang sems rnam pa lngas/ rgyud lnga'i sems can thar ba'i lam la sbyor/ bdud dang dam sri nag po'i phyogs rnams kun/ kun tu bsdigs shing thal bar brlag bya'i phyir/ dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu cher 'bar ba'i/ ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i sdig mjub gdengs/ srid gsum gdug pa mata' dag tshar bcad nas/ dug gsum sku gsung thugs su sgrol byed cing*/ (239)'khor ba'i g.yul ngo gtan nas pham mjad pa'i/ dpa' bo rgyal rtags kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum thogs/ khro rgyal ma lus 'dus pa'i rtsal 'chang zhing*/ mi bzad stong khams bsreg pa'i me stag 'phro/ btab na ye shes lha yang thal bar rlog 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od zer can/ ri rab brjid pa'i phur pa drag tu 'dril/ khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo che la bstod/ gar gyi (240)dbang phyug rnam par 'gyur ba'i sku/ dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams yongs rdzogs shing*/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyad kyi dor stabs kyis/ dregs pa lha chen gnon mjad khyod la bstod/ hūm̐/ mche ba zangs yag gtsigs pa'i za byed che/

rab 'bar nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer 'phro/ khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug 'dra'i rngams stabs can/ mi bzad sku yi dngos po shin tu 'gyur/ rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin/ thug (241)chom ri rab 'bum phrag bsnyil ba'i skad/ gad rgyangs drag pos 'jig rten g.yo zhing 'debs/ spyug pa'i 'thor rlung kun tu g.yengs ba che/ hoḥ khro bo shes rab ye shes me bo che/ ye shes chen po'i 'od zer kun tu gsal/ 'bar ba'i ye shes ma rig mun pa 'joms/ snying po ye shes sna tshogs thig le che/ hoḥ ye shes dkyil 'khor khro bo'i sprin chen po/ 'phros pas dkyil 'khor kun gyi char (242)chen 'bebs/ phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gter/ rnam pa sna tshogs ye shes thig le che/ hoḥ bdud rnams kun gyi bdud de bdud chen po/ 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i tshogs kyang 'jigs par byed/ srid zhi'i 'ching ba thams cad 'joms mjad pa/ dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i btsun mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ kun tu bzang mo dkyil 'khor (243)kun gyi yum/ gdug pa 'dul phyir srin mo khros pa'i gzugs/ srid pa'i 'khor lo ye shes rgya yis 'debs/ gnyis med don ldan yab la dgyes par 'khril/ phyag g.yas 'khor los bdud kyi mgo lus gshog g.yon pas thod khrag 'khor 'das dbang du sdud/ 'jigs pa'i sku la phyag rgya lnga yis spras/ drag po'i nga ros 'jig rten g.yo zhing 'khrugs/ rgyud lnga'i sems (244)can thugs rjes dbyings su sgrol/ srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs rnams thal bar rlog mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso mo khyed la bstod/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i khro rgyal chen po bcu/ mi dge bcu spangs dge bcu rdzogs pa'i sku/ kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug gtum la rngams/

phyogs skyong dregs pa pho mo (245)thams cad 'dul/ dbu skra ral pa srid pa'i rtse mor 'bar/ mi sdug khro gnyer smin mtshams g.yo ba can/ spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs/ log par lta ba rtsad nas gcod cing sgrol/ mche ba zangs yag skye shi rtsad nas gcod/ gdug pa 'dul mjad 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan bsnams/ dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du che/ rdo rje rin chen gshog pa (246)nam mkhar gdengs/ rngams pa'i zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb/ kun kyang phur pa 'dril zhing phyogs bcur 'debs/ thabs dang shes reb gnyis med yum dang 'khril/ g.yas g.yon dag tu sprul pa'i phra thabs ni/ mgo brnyan mche gshog rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs ldan/ 'bar ba'i khro rgyal ma bcos rdzogs pa'i sku/ sgra las 'das pa grags stong hūm̐ sgra gsung*/ bsam dang bral ba sgrol byed snying po'i ngang*/ yon tan phrin (247)las thams cad rdzogs pa'i dpal/ sprul pa chen po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ gnyis ma'i sku la 'khril ba'i gzungs mchog ma/ rngams brjid 'jigs pa khro mo'i cha lugs can/ pha rol phyin pa bcu yi ngo bo nyid/ bdud 'dul yum gyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi/ dgra bgegs gdug pa 'gug 'ching sdom zhing rdeg shar (248)lho nub byang sgo srung drag shul can/ sgo ma chen mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'akor nas/ dpal gyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya/ mthing nag khros pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas dang po s+t+wa re ltag par 'phyar/ 'og mas rdo rje ri rab mnon stabs 'jin/ g.yon pa'i phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khrol zhing*/ 'og mas phur bu dgra bgegs snying la 'debs/ (249)rigs lngas dbu rgyan thugs srog hūm̐ du 'bar/ snyan nas 'brug sgrog spyan nas me 'od 'phro/ shangs nas rlung 'tshubs zhal nas thog ser 'bebs/

mche ba gtsigs shing ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ khyod kyi lte ba man chad chas rnams ni/ lcags phur zur gsum me stag tsha tshwa 'phro/ dgra bgegs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams skad cig sgrol/ mi g.yo che mchog sku gsung thugs kyi (250)ngang*/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ srid par 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad kun/ thabs kyis bsgral ba'i skal dang mi ldan yang*/ shugs kyis sgrol ba'i phrin las mjad slad du/ dbyer med sku gsung thugs su sgrol mjad pa/ sras mchog kī la ya la phyag 'tshal bstod/

ces bstod do/ ༈ phur pa'i dzap+da bshags bzhugs so/ hūm̐/ chos sku rang byung thig le gsal ba las/ bcom ldan (251)dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ thig le'i dbyings las byung ba don ma rtogs/ bka' dang gzhung las 'dal ba mthol lo bshags/ chos nyid ngang gis gsal ba'i bdag nyid ma/ kro dhī shwa ri 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku/ pad+ma'i dbyings las shar ba'i don ma rtogs/ bka' dang gzhung las 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ stong nyid thig le'i ye shes rang gsal las/ dregs pa (252)bdud 'dul khro rgyal yab yum sku/ ye shes dbyings las shar bar don ma rtogs/ bka' dang gzhung las 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ ye shes dbyings las sprul pa'i phra men ma/ gdug pa'i mgo can dbang drag las mjad pa/ drag shul phra men thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ bka' dang gzhung las 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ kun bzang bde chen bha ga'i pho brang nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes chen (253)po ni/ nyon mongs sgrol mjad sras mchog kī la ya/ bka' dang gzhung las 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ ye shes thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ tshoms rno mche gtsigs yid las mgyogs pa yis/ dgra bgegs sgrol mjad shwa na mu kha ma/ bka' dang gzhung las 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ mi mngon dbyings nas legs nyes stangs 'jin cing*/ gsur (254)chen khrag gi dri snom gsang chen ma/ bdag nyid chen mo nag ma 'khor bcas kyi/ bka' dang gzhung las 'gal gu h+ya ba mthol lo bshags/ bka' gsang gzhung mnos rdo rje lho bal tshogs/ theg chen bskyangs shing nyams bsgral zhal 'ches ma/ seng ha chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ bka' dang gzhung las 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ bzod par gsol nas tshangs par stsal du gsol/ zhes bshags so/ (255)rang nyid dpal chen po 'khor bcas su lhag par gsalal bas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bhigh+naṃ baṃ dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi 'od zeraljang nag ba thag gzengs pa lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i rtse las sras mchog lta bu'i khro bo'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros stong gsum thams cad gang*/

(256)dngos sna sku/ sgra grags gsung*/ rtogs tshogs thugs sgrol byed gsal bas/ dkyil 'khor gsum sogs bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ srung ma dam can thams cad kyi srog bcud la phab nas sgrol ba'i las la btsu/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi g.yar dam por stsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ bla na med pa'i gnas su bsgral/ gzas po'i (257)gnas su 'phros pas gang la bya ba de dag bkug nas ling ga la bstim pas dngos su gyur nas 'khu mi nus par brub khung du gsalal/ 'od zer slar 'dus nas bdag dang phur bu rnams la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs dpag med du gyur/ 'phros pa'i khro bo phur bu'i gzugs can rnams bsgral bya'i zhing rnams la btab pas spyi btsugs nas rkang mthil du phyung lus (258)bsgral lce steng nas lkog mar phyung ngag bsgral/ snying gar thog ltar lhung bas srog rtsa thal bar byas/ sems kyi bag chags bsgral/ mdor na phur bu'i char rgyun ma chad par lhung bas dgra bgegs kyi sgo gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad phye mar brlag par bsam la drag tu bzla'o/ sngags la spel tshig gzhung tshul ni gtso bo la sngar bzhin dang*/ khro bo bcu la rtsa ba'i sngags mthar/ dgra bgegs che ge mo garja garja (259)hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mtshungs par sbyar/ sras mchog la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ srung ma rnams dril ba la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mo hā gh+ra ta ya ma ma shī gh+raṃ karma ka ra ye dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang drag sngags 'dus pa la/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyi gong du/ dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya sbyar ro/ ༈ de nas dam can gyi bsnyen pa ni/ mchod gtor rnams bsang sbyang ye shes kyis bdud rtsir (260) byin gyis brlabs la/ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis phur srung dam can bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa so so'i gnas nas spyan drangs par

bsam la rkang gling dang bshugs pas drangs ba'i rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ bh+yo/ stong gsum 'di na dregs pa can/ sogs drag sngags rgya mtsho'i yang gces gtong zhing gzhan yang dam can spyi'i gtor ma bsngo/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ btab phur gcig gam bcu gcig gam bco lnga la sogs pa mdun du bkod la/ oṃ badz+ra (261)kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ garja garja hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi ja ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la dan+t+ra hūm̐/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya man+ta ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ar+ya a tsa la hūm̐/ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hūm̐/ gu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ (262)oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun ḍa li hūm̐/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dzā ya hūm̐/ bhin+dha bh-in+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags kyi spyi bor hūm̐ kā ra/ rgya mdud gong ya la phyogs kyi khro bo/ 'og ma la mtshams kyi khro bo/ zur bzhi la sgo ma chu srin kha la stobs po che/ dpal la dam can bskyed la/ de rnams kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ (263)oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra sa ma ya jaḥ ma hā pu ja hoḥ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mchod pas mchod la bstim zhing*/ dbang bskur spro na/ rdo rje thal mos phur pa bsgril zhing dpral bar bzung la/ ha na ha na dib+ta tsakra oṃ/ mgrin par/ shī ri badz+ra ka'i la ya aḥ snying gar bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa rwa ja hūm̐/ gis rim pa bzhin du sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi sgo nas khams gsum sgrol ba'i mthu dang ldan par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la be ta li maṇ+ḍal rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ (264)phur pa la yungs dkar gtor zhing mthu dang ldan par bsam zhing*/

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma gu ta la aṣ+ṭhi ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ gu gul gyis bdug cing gzi mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ha rak+ta dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ rak+ta gtor la chags pa dang ldan par bsam/ de nas dkyil 'khor gsum dang dam can gyi bstod bskul rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ ༈ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal drag po bskyed/ chos dbang phur pa spu gri las/ bla ma rig 'jin dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dam can srung (265)ma dang bcas pa thams cad drag po mngon spyod kyi las la bzhengs shing sprul pa'i pho nya nam mkha' gang bar tsam spro bar dmigs la rig 'jin bskul/ hūm̐/ byang chub mchog tu sogs/ dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha rnams bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ mi gnas dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ shin tu mi bzad 'jigs (266)pa'i sku/ mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ zhing chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ stag lpags grol ba'i sham thabs can/ rdo rje me dpung 'khrugs pa'i tshul/ khrag dang zhag gi tshom bu sogs/ dur khrod rol pa'i rgyan cha can/ de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum/ bde chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ yab yum thabs shes rol ba las/ sprul pa khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ za gsod pho (267)nya'i dmag tshogs dang*/ 'khor gyi ma mo dam can rnams/ re ba thams cad bskang ba'i phyir/ dam tshig bzhin du gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig bzhin du gshegs nas kyang*/ slob dpon la ni brnyas byed dang*/ dam tshig gnyan po 'dral byed dang*/ rdo rje'i mched la 'khu byed dang*/ mi byams sdang la nye ring med/ dam las 'da' na mched kyang rung*/ gnod par byed na lha (268)yang rung*/ yas kyi bdud dang mas kyi sri/ rno ba'i mtshon dang sbyar ba'i dug snga dgra lag brdar phyi dgra sems/ da dgra bsam ngan sbyor rtsub pa/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang*/

bstan pa gnyan po 'jig pa rnams/ lo yi dus las 'das ta re/ zla ba'i mal nas yol ta re/ sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs/ thams cad ma lus myur du khug lcags kyu can gyis snying nas drongs/ (269)zhags pa can gyis rked nas chings/ lcags sgrog can gyis dbang po sdom/ dril bu can gyis rnam shes sgyur/ rdo rje can gyis rgyab nas phul/ mche ba can gyis spyi nas choms/ lcags kyu can gyis snying nas gzhibs/ gshog pa can gyis mtha' nas chums/ nu ma can gyis sdebs su gzhibs/ gan bub nag po bsreg la shog las kyis rlung (270)gis gshams nas btegs/ 'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas bsus/ ltag pa'i bdud sgo phyes la shog dpral ba'i mig phyung khong snying thon/ rang dbang med par drongs shig khug yud tsam gyis ni 'dir bkug nas/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du shig rnam shes tshangs pa'i lam nas spor/ ma g.yel bcol ba'i phrin las rnams/ dam tshig tshul bzhin grub par mjod/ ces (271) bskul/ dam can rnams bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ sngon tshe sgrub pa'i gnas mchog nas/ lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum ma/ bse yi 'phar ba lce brgyad ma/ g.yu mi khyi mo ral pa can/ nga ro 'brug tu ldir zhing zug kha rlangs sprin du 'khyil zhing 'thib/ mig ni nyi ma'i zer bzhin 'bar/ bang ni glog gis 'gran mi nus/ spu ni (272)mtshon cha'i so ltar rno/ de 'dra'i chibs kyis brjid tshul la/ 'jigs pa'i mi mo bzang mo zhon/ g.yas pas rdo rje thod phreng 'dren/ g.yon pa rin chen phur bu 'dril/ mu kha mched bzhi'i dus la bab/ 'dir spyon bcol pa'i phrin las mjod/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub pas/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mjod/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ (273)su ru su ru badz+ra/ mu ru mu ru badz+ra/ dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ bh+yo/

bying byed mtsho la gnas bcas shing*/ rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i sna 'dren/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ mi lpags rlon pa sku la gsol/ phyag na spu gri rnon po thogs/ chibs su dril rta rkang gsum chibs/ 'dir spyon bcol pa'i phrin las mjod/ (274)dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub pas/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mjod/ hūm̐/ bar snang khams su rten bcas shing*/ 'brug dang glog gi sna 'dren ma/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba la/ btsos dmar la'u sku la gsol/ khrag skam lcags kyu phyag na bsnams/ chu glang sngon po chibs su chibs/ 'dir spyon bcol pa'i phrin las (275)mjod/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub pas/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mjod/ hūm̐/ ri rab rtse la rten bcos shing*/ sad dang ser ba'i sna 'dren ma/ dpal ldan nag mo re ma ju/ sku mdog ser nag 'bar ba la/ bya yi thul pa sku la gsol/ phyag na gser gyi zor ba bsnams/ chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs/ 'dir spyon (276)bcol pa'i phrin las mjod/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub pas/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mjod/ bh+yo/ sa yi gling du rten bcas shing*/ kha ba bu yug sna 'dren ma/ dpal ldan nag mo re ma ju/ sku mdog ljang nag 'bar ba la/ chu dar thul pa sku la gsaul/ phyag na bdud kyi khram bam bsnams/ rnga mo sngo nag chibs su chibs/ 'dir spyon (277)bcol pa'i phrin las mjod/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub pas/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mjod/ hūm̐ ma ma wa shaṃ ku ru ma dhaṃ e ka ra i dan dha ti ma ma karma shī gh+raṃ ka ra ye gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ bal yul ya byin yul la brten/ mar khu'i mtsho la mnga' yang mjad/ rdo rje ya byin mthu (278)mo che/

sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ mthing nag ber chen sku la gsol/ phyag na bdud zhags lcags kyu bsnams/ bdud rta nag po chibs su bcibs/ 'dir spyon bcol pa'i phrin las mjod/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub pas/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mjod/ hūm̐/ rong gi de phyin yul la brten/ zhags gi mtsho la mnga' (279)yang mjad/ rdo rje de byin rtsal mo che/ sku mdog ser nag 'bar ba la/ ber chen ser nag sku la gsol/ gser zhabs gser phur phyag na bsnams/ chibs su gza' rta ser po chibs/ 'dir spyon bcol pa'i phrin las mjod/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub pas/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mjod/ hūm̐/ mang yang bse byin (280)yul la brten/ khrag gi mtsho la mtha' yang mjad/ rdo rje bse byin 'phrul mo che/ sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba la/ ber chen dmar nag sku la gsol/ btsan zhags seng lding phur bu bsnams/ chibs su btsan rta dmar po bcibs/ 'dir spyon bcol ba'i phrin las mjod/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub pas/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur (281)du mjod/ hūm̐/ snye nam phag byin yul la brten/ 'o ma'i mtsho la mnga' yang mjad/ rdo rje phag byin mthu mo che/ sku mdog sngo nag 'bar ba la/ ber chen sngo nag sku la gsol/ g.yu zhags mchong phur phyag na bsnams/ g.yu rta sngon po chibs su bcibs/ 'dir spyon bcol pa'i phrin las mjod/ dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag (282)sgrub pas/ bcaul pa'i phrin las myur du mjod/ ka ṭa ka ṭa ye/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a ji te a pa rā ji te mā ra se na pra marta na/ dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sman raka gtor mar sgreng zhing bskul lo/ de nas pho nya 'gugs pa'i 'phyong ba dang*/ gser skyems sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs pa ni/

oṃ swa bha ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā ba shud+dho3 haṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha (283)ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki ti na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa smi bha ba sa ma ya ma ha ma ṇi du ru du ru hrī da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ gra he shwa ra pra bha dz+ye ti ni ma hā sa maya swā hā/ hoḥ bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod (284)pa 'di 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ kunatu bzang po nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ yab dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu/ yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ 'jigs pa'i khro bo yab yum nyi shu/ sprul pa stag gi mgo can la sogs pa mche ba (285)can gyi tshogs/ bya rgod kyi mgo can la sogs pa gshog pa can gyi tshogs/ mthar byed sgo la/ sprul pa sras mchog dam can srung ma/ ging chen dge bsnyen rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang zhi ba sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ 'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung*/ yang dag thugs/ (286)bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur pa phrin las/ ma mo rbod gtong*/ rig 'jin slob dpon/ 'chi med tshe/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ drag sngags dmod pa/ sgrub chen sde dgu/ bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'jin rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i (287)rgyud la sogs pa gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsaul/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mgon po sogs dang*/ dgos kyi chos skyong*/ gzhan yang phyogs skyong*/ (288)zhing skyong*/ lha chen/ klu chen/ 'jigs byed/ gza' skar/ rgyal chen sde bzhi la sogs pa mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang stod cig khyad par du yang bstan pa spyi'i dgra/ blal ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ rnal 'byor pa'i dgos dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa (289)can 'di bsgral ba'i phrin las mjod cing*/ gzhan yang sde brgyad sde bcu gzhi bdag sogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyed rnams la phur ba'i dbal mi ston/ yungs dkar gyi thun mi 'phen/ khrag gi zor mi brdeg drag po'i pho nya mi 'gyed pas/ mtho ba rnams ko long dang phrag dog ma byed dma' ba rnams ma 'jigs ma skrag par rang rang so so'i gnas su 'dug la/ (290)rnal 'byor pa'i sdong grogs kyis la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i grogs mjod cig mthu dang stobs med na chos thams cad bsam pa'i khyad par yin pas bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyis shig gzhan yang khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la bsngo'o/

zhes smon lam gdab/ ༈ gzu dpang bzhugs/ hūm̐/ steng gi phyogs su kha bltas te/ mi mjed tshangs pa 'khor bcas la/ lta ba'i don (291)gyi 'brel ba la/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin rlabs kyis/ snang srid khro bor dbang bskur nas/ sgul skyod phur pa'i rang bzhin pas/ tshangs pa mi mjed 'khor bcas kyang*/ dbang med 'dar zhing skrag srid pas/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin rlabs kyis/ dmigs pa po la ma gtogs pa/ tshangs pa 'khor la mi 'debs kyi/ do nub gzu dang dpang mjod cig ā+oṃ tri marta pra ni da la 'gi na (292)'gi ti sa ma ya hūm̐/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang na/ lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang*/ nye dbang sum cu 'khor bcas kyang*/ snang srid khro bor bdag bsgom pas/ de kun 'dar zhing skrag srid pas/ rdo rje gzhon ni'i byin rlabs kyis/ dmigs po la ma gtogs pa/ brgya byin gnas su mi 'debs kyi/ do nub gzu dang dpang mjod cig ngos bzhi'i rgyal chen rigs bzhi yang*/ snang srid (293)khro bor bdag bsgom pas/ sgul bskyod thams cad phur pa ste/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin rlabs kyis/ dmigs pa po la ma gtogs pa/ rgyal chen bzhi la mi 'debs kyi/ do nub gzu dang dpang mjod cig 'og gi klu rgyal 'khor bcas kyang*/ snang srid khro bor bdag bsgom pas/ sgul bskyod thams cad phur pa ste/ sa bdag klu gnyan 'dar srid pas/ rdo rje (294)gzhon nu'i byin rlabs kyis/ dmigs pa po la ma gtogs pa/ sa bdag klu la mi 'debs kyis/ do nub gzu dang dpang mjod cig bar snang khams na gnas pa yi/ gza' dang rgyu skar 'khor bcas kyang*/ snang srid khro bo bdag bsgom pas/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin rlabs kyis/ dmigs pa po ma gtogs pa/ khyed la phur bu mi 'debs kyis/ do nub gzu dang dpang mjod cig srid pa'i lha 'dre la de skad bya/ (295) phud btang zhing bden pa brdar ro/ ༈ de nas dngos gzhi sprul pa spro ba ni/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag gi thugs las 'phros pa'i pho nya ni/ khro bo 'chaul ba dpag tu med pa byung */ srid pas gar khyab gnam sa bar snang kun/ ras bal rlung gis gtor bzhin khyab par gyur/ skabs 'dir yang 'gug gzhug bya'o/ gdab las dngos ni/ rtsa ba las/ gab pa'i sngags drug gis/ (296) bsad pa'i las baya/ sbas pa'i 'phyong drug gis drag po'i las gzhung bsrang*/ tshe lung khrus lus gis dgongs pa phul du phyung*/ gnod pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir phur pa btab la/ khams gsum dus gcig tu bsgral ba'i mchod pa bya/ ye shes lha la dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gi phyag rgyas sha khrag zha du bstab cing kho'i rnam shes bdag la brdzus la skur gdon/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gsum gyis bskyed rdzogs rnam gsum gyis dgra bgegs gnas bstab/ don chos nyid las mi 'da' ba'i phyir chos nyid kyi bden pa brdar/ zhes so/ ༈ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs bar pa bshags pa yan (297) tshar ba'i rjes de nyid du bskang ba bya ba ni/ bdud rtsi/ rak+ta/ mar me/ ja gad/ māṃ sa/ tshe/ zla rgyas/ bam gtsang ma/ gsur chen/ bza' bca' sna tshogs dang bcas pa bshams shing thogs te rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ snang srid phur bus gdab pa'i phyir/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang*/ khams gsum 'khor ba rgyas 'debs phyir/ 'khor lo rgyas 'debs thugs dam bskang*/ mi dge bcu po tshar gcod phyir/ khro (298)rgyal yab bcu'i thugs dam bskang*/ dge bcu dang du blang ba'i phyir/ khro mo bcu yi thugs dam bskang*/ phyogs bcur sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir/ khra thabs nyi shu'i thugs dam bskang*/ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phyir/ phur pa sras kyi thugs dam bskang*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las sgrub phyir/ phrin las bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ slob dpon sku dgra sgrol ba'i phyir/

shwa na mched (299)bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ bstan pa'i spyi dgra sgrol ba'i phyir/ re ti mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ rnal 'byor dgos dgra sgrol ba'i phyir/ bse mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ myur mgyogs drag po'i las mjad phyir/ bse lcags dung gsum thugs dam bskang*/ 'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom myos bya'i phyir/ sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ ru tra se gsum (300)'dul ba'i phyir/ ging chen bco brgyad thugs dam bskang*/ phyogs bcur dmag dpung dbab pa'i phyir/ ma bdun sring bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ phrin las rgya mtsho sgrub pa'i phyir/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad thugs dam bskang*/ zhes dang gzhan yang*/ bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang*/ ba ling gtor mas thugs dam (301)bskang*/ rak+ta dmar gyis thugs dam bskang*/ zhal zas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ dkyil 'khor zhal gyis thugs dam bskang*/ ja gad phud kyis thugs dam bskang*/ zhun chen mar me thugs dam bskang*/ srog dbugs mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ gsur chen dri yis thugs dam bskang*/ rol mo sgra yi thugs dam bskang*/ bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub (302)stsol/ g.yar dam gnyen po sor stsol cig de nas rdzas rnams bzhag te skong ba phyir zlog tu thal mo gdab cing*/ de ltar bskang bas bskang gsos nas/ 'di ltar bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ yas kyis bdud g.yos phyir la zlog mas kyi sri langs phyir la zlog nye ba'i byol po phyir la zlog yul pa'i 'grim chags phyir la zlog pha tshan rgyab 'dre phyir la (303)zlog ma bu'i byur 'dre phyir la zlog gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor phyir la zlog ma mo'i khrag zor phyir la zlog bdud kyi khram kha phyir la zlog btsan gyi gzer kha phyir la zlog sa bdag dug phyed phyir la zlog

rgyal pa'i smyo 'bogs phyir la zlog gza' yi king kang phyir la zlog mu stegs ngan sngags phyir la zlog the brang sri rkun phyir la zlog nad kha rim kha phyir la (304)zlog sngags pa'i phur kha phyir la zlog bon gyi zor kha phyir la zlog sum pa'i glang zor phyir la zlog mo nyag 'bol le phyir la zlog lo zla zhag keg phyir la zlog mo ngan rmi ngan phyir la zlog ltas ngan mtshan ngan phyir la zlog pho brgya'i mda' brdar mtshon kha bzlog mo brgya'i dug g.yos zas kha bzlog mi nag skye bo'i ya ga bzlog bran 'khor ngan (305)pa'i mod mchu bzlog dgra la bh+yo la bsgral du gsol/ bgegs la bh+yo rdul du rlog ces bskang bzlog drag tu bya ste/ 'di ni tshogs kyis le lag yin no/ ༈ de na tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pa ni/ hūm̐ a/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi gnas gsum a dkar las/ a dkar 'od zer phra mo grangs med 'phros/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te/ a yi rang bzhin nyid du (306)thams cad zhu/ bdag dang khro bo phur pa la thim pas/ lus ngag yid kyi shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ phyag rgya chen por gsal te bdag gi khrus/ a/ bdag gi gnas gsum a las 'od 'phros pas/ rgyal ba mchod cing 'gro drug sdig sgrib sbyangs/ srid gsum a yi rang bzhin byang chub sems/ 'od kyi gong bur gsal te snang srid khrus/ a/ thams cad byang sems gyur te 'od gsal ba/ (307)mtha' nas rim gyis 'dus te gzas po yi/ sgo gsum thim nas lus ngag yid sgrib sbyangs/ a yi rang bzhin byang chub sems su zhu/ 'od kyi gong bur gyur te gzas po'i khrus/ de ltar khrus lung rnam pa gsu po rdzogs/ de nas tshe lung 'di ltar gsal gdab ste/ hūm̐/ gzas po'i snying dkyil pad+ma 'dab bzhi gyes pa yi/ bzhi mdor rtsa yi dwangs ma 'dus de'i nang*/ khrag gi dwangs ma (308)bye'u yi ni mgo bo tsam/ de la dbugs dang 'od kyi dwangs ma chags shing gnas/

'od kyi thag pa tshe tshad dang mnyam ring thung gis/ ba thag lta bur drwa bas gtums te gnas pa la/ de rnams dbus na rnam shes rten ni 'od du gnas/ de ltar phur pa btab pa'i yul nges par byas la/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ mo ha ghā ta ya/ bha ga wān/ hriḥṣ+ṭi bī kri/ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ja (309)hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bigh+naṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ a phaṭa/ sngags kyi phur pa snying gar btab la ting 'jin gsal te 'di ltar bsgom par bya'o/ hūm̐/ phur ba'i 'od kyas pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi/ bya sgro mer bcug lta bur thul gyis bsreg 'byung ba bzhi la btab pa zhes bya'o/ rtsa bzhi chon thag bsdus pa bzhin du gyur/ de ni 'byung po'i rgyu bzhir btab (310)pa'o/ rtsa bzhi'i dwangs ma 'dus pas phur rtse la/ sbrul 'khyud lta bur hril gyis 'dril gyur nas/ de ni zhe sdang ni rgyu bzhi'i dwangs ma zhe sdang bcad/ de yi dbugs rta drod kyi dwangs ma de/ me la chu blugs bzhin du zhi gyur cing*/ dbugs kyi rta bsgral phrag dog rtsad bcad pa'o/ de la 'od kyi dwangs ma chags pa de/ khab len rdo bzhin phur pa la 'dus pas/ rdo tshan kha ba babs ltar (311)bskam par bsam/ sems kyi yul phyung nga rgyal rtsad bcad pa'o/ de yi khrag gi dwangs ma sbal ba'o/ lcags bsreg chu thigs phog bzhin bskam par bsgom/ dwangs ma gnad sleb 'dod chags rtsad bcad pa'o/ tshe skud ba thag drwa bas gtum pa de/ rtsi sbur me lce 'phrad pa lta bur tshig tshe yi rten phral gti mug rtsa bcad pa'o/ de rnams dbus (312)kyi tshe yi rten gyur pa/ a zhes brjod pas ar gyur phur rtse sbyar/ bo dhi tsit+ta oṃ/ bo dhi tsit+ta āḥ bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐/ bdag la bstim/ bdag la bstim pas bdag nyid lhag par yang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi gzi byin cher rgyas te/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du gnas pa ni/

bkrag mdangs 'phrog pas bdag gi tshe lung ngo*/ kho yi rnam shes bdag gi thugs ka ru/ a ru gnas pa (313)tshigs pa'i lam nas phyungs/ rlung sgrom shangs nas dung khang gzhal yas sogs/ sgal tshigs rta brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas phyungs/ 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum gyi mkha' ru babs/ hūm̐ gsum gyur pa phaṭa gsum gyis 'phangs bas/ 'og min rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sbyor mtshams thim/ hūm̐ de rdo rje de las rdo rje sems/ ye shes rang bzhin gnas pa (314)kho'i tshe lung*/ de'ang rgyud las/ rnam shes ye nas dag pa rgyal ba'i sras/ dug lnga gnas su dag pa ye shes lnga/ de kho na kho yi tshe lung bstan/ ces so/ de nas thun gsum gyis brab/ mtshon cha'i char phab/ phur pa la bdud rtsi'i skyems phul la ling ga la btab la bzhag go ༈ bstab pa'i rjes su/ bai drul sngon po'i rin chen ri rab la/ nyi ma stong gi 'od zer gdal ba ltar/ sems dpa' sngon po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/ dpal chen gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod/ 'od (315)phung stug po sprin ltar 'khrugs pa'i dbus/ 'jigs byed rngams stabs brkyangs bskum tshul du bzhugs/ za byed bskal pa'i me dpung bzhin du 'bar/ gdug pa thams cad rdo rje'i zhal du 'dren/ mi bzad mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal gdangs shing*/ srid gsum za bar byed pa'i rkan sgra can/ nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ bgegs dpung bsreg par mjad la (316)phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces che ba'i yon tan gyis bstod do/ de nas rnga gdeng ba re dang bcas/ chos nyid kyi bden pa'o/ sogs kyis chos nyid kyis bden pa brdar ro/ ༈ de nas gso ba gsum gyi dgongs pa 'byung ste/ ting nge 'jin gyi gso ba ni/ phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu nyid nas 'byung ba lta bu yin te/ dang po sgrub bya'i snying gar phur pa bsgril te/ kī li kī la ya/ zhes lan bco brgyud bzlas pas/ phur bu'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis sgrub bya'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma thams cad dag nas/

sems dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis tshul du phur pa la 'dus pas gzas (317) pa po khams gsum du gtan mi 'khor bar bsgom/ de nas phur pa nam mkha' la bskor te/ kī li kī la ya/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pas/ phur ba'i gzi bayin bskyed de khams gsum gang bar dmigs nas/ ye shes kyi 'od 'bar bar bsgom pas phyag rgya'i lha rnams la nyes pas ma gos pas gzi byin chen pa dang ldan par bsgom mo/ de nas bdag gi thugs kar bzung la/ kī li kī la ya/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas/ phur pa ye shes kyi 'od zer du gyur te bdag gi thugs kar thim pas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis sku (318)gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo/ hom gyi skabs su bstab la bsreg las grub kyi bar du gso bar mi bya'o/ phur pa gso ba'i dus ni phrin las shin tu mnar ba dag rtsom pa'i dus su nam las grub pa dang de nas gdod gso bar bya'o/ las ma grub par gso ba sngas na las myur du mi grub pa'i rgyu yin no/ zhes zla ma'i man ngag go ༈ de nas bsngo ba ni/ phur pa zhe sdang yongs su dag pa'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa las/ khrag 'thung rigs su skyes nas kyang*/ mnyam med rdo rje gzhon nu ston/ snying rje ldan zhing bla mar gus/ skye zhing skye bar (319)'gyur bar shog lag na rdo rje phur bu 'jin/ zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*/ btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog ces dang*/ dge ba 'di yi bdag dang sems can kun/ bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa'i par/ 'bras bu byang chub nges par brnyes gyur cig ces dge ba bsngo/ de nas (320) bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kyis ni bdud pham mjad/ chos ma yin ni chos kyis so/ dge 'dun gyis ni mu stegs pham/ dbang pos lha min pham gyur te/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs kyis/
dgra bgegs rnams ni pham par mjad/ rig sngags bden pa'i mthu 'di ni/ thogs pa med par 'grub par mjod/ ces rig pa ngar dang ldan par brjod do/// /
